aero_suite.feature.spark_wand.desc: Combat wand with fire damage and anti-arthropod bonus; right-click a contraption for mass readout and center markers, Shift for heavy-block mode with buoyancy.
aero_suite.feature.portable_diagram.desc: Right-click a physics vehicle to open its machine diagram directly.
aero_suite.feature.counterweight.desc: Manually adjustable mass block (1-20) via sequenced assembly; includes intermediate deletion.
aero_suite.feature.counterweight_redston: Redstone-driven mass tier (1-16) with light strip indicator.
aero_suite.feature.counterweight_light.d: Manually adjustable buoyancy block (1-36) via sequenced assembly; includes intermediate deletion.
aero_suite.feature.counterweight_light_p: Pearlescent skin of the Counterweight "Light", identical physics.
aero_suite.feature.recipe_heavy_core.des: Sequenced assembly on iron blocks with a 20% chance of a Heavy Core.
aero_suite.feature.analog_transmission.d: Analogue transmission mapping redstone 0-15 to fixed RPM.
aero_suite.feature.variable_speed_engine: Scroll-adjustable speed (32-256, 15 steps); covers all 16 dyed variants.
aero_suite.feature.sequential_feeder.des: Programmable feed tape: 9 ghost slots + 9 inventory slots, redstone-pulsed; includes intermediate deletion.
aero_suite.feature.single_slot_hopper.de: Vanilla hopper behaviour, but 1 slot holding exactly 1 item (no stacking); keeps repeated items separate for the Sequential Feeder.
aero_suite.feature.stabilizer.desc: PD controller keeping contraptions level, mass/buoyancy modes; includes intermediate deletion.
aero_suite.feature.world_anchor.desc: Cross-dimensional logistics block using package delivery; includes intermediate deletion.
aero_suite.feature.addressing_sign.desc: Transparent wall sign holding an address list for machines to read.
aero_suite.feature.activated_pearl.desc: Player-bound ender pearl shipped in a package; teleports the player after 3s, cross-dimensional.
aero_suite.feature.starlight_casing.desc: Starlight-tinted copper casing, can encase fluid pipes.
aero_suite.feature.void_hose_pulley.desc: Endlessly drains Starlight fluid from the End Sea region.
aero_suite.feature.starlight_bucket.desc: Bucket form of Starlight fluid; poured fluid does not spread.
aero_suite.feature.starlight_bottle.desc: Filled with a glass bottle at the End Sea; crafting/brewing ingredient.
aero_suite.feature.recipe_starlight_brew: A Starlight Bottle can replace the Awkward Potion as a brewing base in the brewing stand - add a main ingredient directly to brew potions, skipping nether wart farming.
aero_suite.feature.zinc_lump.desc: Crafted from 3 zinc nuggets; converts into prismarine products with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.recipe_levitite.desc: Sequenced assembly on ultralight glass producing Levitite.
aero_suite.feature.mult_blaze_rod.desc: Mix blaze powder with Starlight to duplicate blaze rods.
aero_suite.feature.mult_glowstone_dust.d: Mix end stone dust with Starlight to duplicate glowstone dust.
aero_suite.feature.mult_redstone.desc: Mix cinder flour with Starlight to duplicate redstone.
aero_suite.feature.mult_experience_block: Compact experience bottles with Starlight into an experience block.
aero_suite.feature.conv_coal.desc: Convert charcoal into coal with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_glow_ink.desc: Convert ink sacs into glow ink sacs with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_prismarine_cryst: Convert zinc lumps into prismarine crystals with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_echo_shard.desc: Convert amethyst shards into echo shards with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_ender_pearl.desc: Convert popped chorus fruit into ender pearls with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_tuff.desc: Convert lava into tuff with Starlight.
aero_suite.feature.conv_prismarine_shard: Convert flint into prismarine shards with Starlight.

aero_suite.feature.pearl_stasis.desc: Single-slot pedestal (always 1 item, right-click access); redstone pulse teleports the bound player of an activated pearl.
jei.starlight_logistics.info.activated_e:
How to obtain:
Hold an Ender Pearl in your main hand and an Echo Shard in your off hand, then right-click.

The pearl binds to you.
Ship it in a Create Package; after existing for 3 seconds the package automatically ruptures and teleports you to the landing point (cross-dimensional).
jei.starlight_logistics.info.starlight_b:
How to obtain:
Bring a Glass Bottle into the End Sea, look down at the void and right-click.

The first bottle must be filled by hand.
Use it to craft the Void Hose Pulley, which draws Starlight endlessly from then on.
